chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluyah (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us, saying: He narrated to me, Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Muhammad ibn Isa, who said: Ibn Fadhal used to narrate from Abu al-Hasan al-Thani (peace be upon him) regarding four things, being a good year (option to return): insanity, leprosy, vitiligo, and blockage of the vagina.
ai.seo_question: What are the four conditions that allow an owner to return a slave within one year according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated by Ibn Fadhal from Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him), establishes four specific conditions—insanity, leprosy, vitiligo, and vaginal blockage—that serve as valid grounds for returning a slave within one year for a price adjustment. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling highlights the concept of 'khiyar al-ajl' (option of time) and ensures fairness in transactions by accounting for latent defects that may not be immediately apparent at the time of purchase.
